mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates aggressive monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL year-over-year inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent price pressures, triggering Fed rate hikes that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate collapsing consumer demand, triggering earnings revisions that drive negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 60-day SPX returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), a declining unemployment rate signals labor market recovery, boosting corporate hiring confidence and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE > 7.0, 20-day SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate revenue visibility and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO remains below 90.0.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% signals economic deceleration, increasing recession risk and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of quarters when GDPC1 QoQ < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market tightening, accelerating wage pressures and boosting equity returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in PAYEMS and decrease in UNRATE fails to generate positive 5-day SPX returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high-rate regimes (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), a decline in the federal funds rate signals policy easing, reducing equity discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0, a rate decline fails to generate positive 20-day SPX returns in at least 60% of cases.
